$comment: Advisories that CI accepts even though `npm audit` reports them.
An entry is only justified while the vulnerable version is pinned outside this repository's control.
Each entry is matched exactly: advisory, module, severity, range, and every reported dependency path.
Anything else fails the audit gate, including an entry that no longer matches a reported advisory.
`reviewBy` time-boxes the exception. CI fails once that date passes, forcing a fresh decision instead of silent drift.
See docs/dependency-audit.md before adding, changing, or extending an entry.

exceptions.reason: brace-expansion is pinned by the npm-shrinkwrap.json published inside @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent. A dependency shrinkwrap is authoritative for its own subtree, so neither a root overrides entry nor `npm audit fix` can raise it to a patched release. Pi 0.82.0 still ships 5.0.7. The package is a development dependency used by the local toolchain and CI on trusted repository inputs, and it is never shipped in the published npm package, which declares Pi as a peer dependency.
exceptions.upstreamFix: Requires @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to bump brace-expansion to >=5.0.9 in its shrinkwrap.

exceptions.reason: Follow-up denial-of-service advisory for the same shrinkwrap-pinned brace-expansion copy: the CVE-2026-14257 mitigation can still be bypassed through unbounded intermediate arrays. The same pinning, trust, and shipping analysis as GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg applies; the package stays a development-only dependency of the local toolchain and CI, and is absent from the published npm package.
exceptions.upstreamFix: Requires @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to bump brace-expansion to >=5.0.9 in its shrinkwrap.

exceptions.reason: undici 8.5.0 is pinned by the npm-shrinkwrap.json published inside @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, so no root override can raise it. Downstream response desynchronization through the retry interceptor requires an attacker-controlled or intercepted HTTP peer; the audited installation is a development dependency used by the local toolchain and CI against trusted registry endpoints, and undici is never shipped in the published npm package, which declares Pi as a peer dependency.
exceptions.upstreamFix: Requires @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to bump undici to >=8.9.0 in its shrinkwrap.

exceptions.reason: Same shrinkwrap-pinned undici copy. Cross-user disclosure and parse-time crashes through degenerate private cache directives require a shared cache fed by a hostile origin. This repository's Pi installation is a development dependency without a shared undici cache, is used only by the local toolchain and CI against trusted registry endpoints, and is never shipped in the published npm package.
exceptions.upstreamFix: Requires @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to bump undici to >=8.9.0 in its shrinkwrap.
